meaning: 游览/旅程的时长或长度
usageNote: 名词短语！说行程多长时间用它，比如问导游'这趟要多久？'超实用！

examples.en: The length of the tour is approximately three hours.
examples.zh: 这次游览大约需要三个小时。

examples.en: Please check the length of the tour before booking your tickets.
examples.zh: 订票前请确认行程的时长。
